faq.title: Commercial FAQ
faq.description: The most common questions we hear from teams evaluating an all-in-one ERP to organize and scale operations.

items.question: How long does implementation usually take?
items.answer: Most teams can start operating in about 5 days. Timing depends on migration volume and process complexity.

items.question: Can we migrate from our current tools?
items.answer: Yes. We review your stack and define a migration approach that avoids disrupting daily operations.

items.question: Is DatumSaaS only for one industry?
items.answer: No. It is designed for operationally complex teams across sectors, including services, retail, and tech.

items.question: What support do we get after starting?
items.answer: You get direct support during go-live and continued guidance as your team consolidates operational gains over the first 90 days.
